items.text: Texans WR Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) ruled OUT for Thursday vs Colts along with Woody Marks (concussion), Brevin Jordan, Danielle Hunter.
items.implication: Nico Collins and remaining HOU WRs see bumped targets Thursday.
items.opportunity: Target share spike for Nico Collins primary beneficiary.

items.text: Andy Reid on Kenneth Walker III groin: getting better but 'don't want to do something stupid.' Levitan agrees fully, notes Chiefs 15.5-pt home favorites vs Cardinals and huge Week 12 at BUF; expects caution and likely another sit.
items.why: Reid explicit caution language + schedule (Thanksgiving next) + Emmett Johnson just delivered 171 yards/2 TDs as fill-in.
items.implication: Walker managers need contingency; do not force start if any doubt.
items.opportunity: Full lead-back workload for Emmett Johnson again (carries + targets) if Walker sits.

items.text: David Montgomery (groin) cleared/full practice context implied for Thursday return vs Colts after missing four games; Woody Marks (concussion) OUT.
items.why: Full practices Mon/Tue; short week but cleared path with Marks in protocol/OUT.
items.implication: Reclaim lead or committee role; cautious on volume in return.
items.opportunity: Carries/red-zone for Montgomery; Marks out boosts him and any other HOU RBs.

items.text: Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield did not practice Wednesday due to a foot injury (previously in walking boot post-Week 9).
items.why: Foot injury from late Week 9; boot through bye.
items.implication: High sit risk vs Lions; monitor Thursday/Friday practices. Rookie Jalon Daniels would start.
items.opportunity: Bucs backup QB and pass-catchers (Irving etc.) volatility.

items.text: FULL CHUB(A) FOR MR. HUBBARD! Chuba Hubbard is my RB6 in rest-of-season rankings.
items.why: Berry elevates to RB6 ROS on sustained production/role.
items.implication: Strong hold/buy in redraft; prioritize in trades before deadline.
items.opportunity: Featured back with clear path and volume.

items.text: No IR for Jordan Addison, per coach Kevin O’Connell.
items.why: Thumb requires surgery/miss multiple weeks but stays off IR.
items.implication: Jefferson/Cousins volume concentrated short-term; Addison stash if deep bench.
items.opportunity: Higher target share for Justin Jefferson and other Vikings WRs while out.

items.text: It's hard for me to find any positives here. Even if you thought Tommy DeVito could play. Hard negatives on entire NE offense post-Drake Maye (potentially season-ending ankle).
items.why: Maye ankle injury (fracture risk); DeVito/Morton bleak; bad remaining schedule.
items.implication: Fade all NE skill players ROS; bye this week softens immediate hit.
items.opportunity: None positive; reverse any prior NE beneficiaries.

items.text: In first game with Kirk Cousins, Vikings set a season-high in Pass Rate Over Expectation. Clear Kevin O'Connell wants to throw a lot.
items.why: Season-high PROE confirms pass-heavy intent under Cousins/O'Connell after prior positive PROE even with bad QB play.
items.implication: Elevated ceiling for Jefferson and Vikings pass catchers ROS, especially favorable playoff DvP (DET/WAS/NYJ).
items.opportunity: Higher dropback volume and targets for WR1.

items.text: We have JT ahead of Chase Brown in the ROS150 half-PPR. In full-PPR, Brown would be further ahead.
items.why: Updated ETR Rest of Season Top-150 half-PPR places Jonathan Taylor over Chase Brown.
items.implication: Trade value edge to JT in half-PPR; reverse in full-PPR.
items.opportunity: Volume/role stability for both, but JT ranked higher half-PPR ROS.

items.text: Brock Bowers left early with ankle; day-to-day, 'not as bad as thought but still significant.' Monitor for Week 11 vs DEN; Mayer next up.
items.why: Coach comments + ETR injury tracking context.
items.implication: High risk sit; even if active limited trust.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer elevated routes/targets if Bowers limited/out.

items.text: Up in pace: TEN @ DAL. Slow paced slogs: MIA @ BUF. Full Week 11 Snaps & Pace from Pat Thorman.
items.why: Titans no-huddle surge (hurry-up rates 29-49% recent) + Cowboys high pace/volume create shootout environment; MIA-BUF projected slog.
items.implication: Stack/volume upside for TEN/DAL skill players; fade low-volume MIA/BUF.
items.opportunity: Elevated plays, targets, carries in TEN-DAL.

items.text: The Jonathan Brooks slappies have a mental illness, it's legit scary. (Dunk on lingering Brooks hype amid limited role/injury history).
items.why: Levitan rejects over-optimism on Brooks fantasy upside.
items.implication: Avoid or sell Brooks; no breakout trust.

items.text: I am CLOSING IT OUT on Jaylen Waddle. The target share is nice. The production is not.
items.why: Targets present but fantasy production failing to materialize; closing the book.
items.implication: Sell/drop candidate in shallower leagues; fade weekly.
items.conflict: Target share still exists but Berry weights production higher.

items.text: Lions placed EDGE Aidan Hutchinson on injured reserve and activated S Kerby Joseph from Reserve/PUP.
items.implication: Lions DL depth hit; minimal fantasy skill impact.
